## Overview

Once you're tracking your code with version control, the next step is making it **visible** and **usable** to others (and your future self). In this session, you'll learn how to document your project, license your code, and share it in ways that encourage collaboration and reuse.

## 🎯 Learning objectives

By the end of this session, you should be able to:

- Write a clear, informative README
- Choose an appropriate licence for your code
- Create vignettes or examples that demonstrate how to use your code
- Set up basic project documentation
- Make your code and analysis discoverable to others

## 📖 Before the session

Please complete the [pre-learning materials](pre-learning.qmd). These typically take 60 – 90 minutes and are essential for getting the most out of the session.
